review_scope: Independent reading of the retained original publisher PDF, including visual inspection of Tables 1 and 8 and the selected methods. Proposed values were checked against the primary document; no candidate packet was used as source evidence. This review supports qualified factual transcription and source-level composition distinctions. Current-catalog novelty, catalog integration, scientific approval and legal clearance remain separate decisions.

source.title: Elastocaloric Performance of Natural Rubber: The Role of Nanoclay Addition
source.hash_check: Independently recomputed from the retained PDF during this review; matched the existing frozen source and the source author's bounded-download receipt.

PDF pp.3-4 section 2.1: source discussion of density, natural MMT and organo-modified MMT
PDF p.4 Table 1: six selected density centers, plus/minus amplitudes, units and printed sample labels
PDF p.16 sections 3.1 and 3.2: input materials, study nomenclature and preparation; Table 7 inspected only to establish its producer-derived boundary

rights.permission_locator: PDF p.1, article-specific copyright and open-access notice
rights.source_copyright_text: Copyright: © 2025 by the authors. Licensee MDPI, Basel, Switzerland.
rights.article_license_notice: The article-specific notice identifies the Creative Commons Attribution license and links to version 4.0.
rights.selected_content: Selected article-authored formulation facts from Table 8, six density cells from Table 1, and supporting input-identity, nomenclature, preparation and density-method statements from sections 2.1, 3.1, 3.2 and 3.3.1.
rights.third_party_credit_check: No separate reproduced/adapted-table credit or third-party permission exception appears in the inspected Table 1 or Table 8 caption, row labels or adjacent notes. Section 2.1 presents Table 1 as results of these study formulations. Citations to prior methods or interpretation are not treated as permission to reproduce the cited works.
rights.excluded_producer_content: Table 7 explicitly states that its information comes from producers. Its clay density values, basal-spacing values, organic-modifier structure drawing and detailed manufacturer composition are excluded from this selected factual import. The article license is not used to upgrade rights in those producer-derived assets.
rights.attribution_required: Retain authors, article title, DOI and the CC-BY-4.0 link. Identify structured transcription, the explicit sample-label mapping and added source-scope qualifications as curation changes.
rights.scope_limit: Only selected source-qualified facts, bibliographic attribution and original review notes are proposed for the repository. The original PDF, page images, figures, source tables as images, source text dumps, producer diagrams and raw measurements remain outside the repository and are not relicensed under the project code license. This evidence is not a legal-clearance conclusion.

formulation_basis.locator: PDF p.16 sections 3.1 and 3.2; p.17 Table 8
formulation_basis.unit_definition: Parts per hundred rubber, explicitly defined by section 3.2 and the Table 8 caption. These are source input formulation parts, not normalized percentages of the complete compound or a measured final-composition assay.

input_identities.rubber: The article identifies Technically Specified Rubber grade SMR 10 as the natural-rubber matrix. This is an input designation, not a certified grade for each finished composite.
input_identities.zdbc: Zinc dibutyldithiocarbamate accelerator, as named in section 3.1.
input_identities.mmt: Section 3.1 identifies natural montmorillonite, with Cloisite Na+ as its commercial input name; section 2.1 calls it natural sodium MMT.
input_identities.ommt: Section 3.1 identifies organo-modified montmorillonite, with Cloisite 20A as its commercial input name. The authors discuss organic amine groups associated with organophilization on pp.3-4. This is an article-stated distinction in filler composition, not an independent chemical assay.

formulation_basis.modifier_scope: The selected article-authored evidence distinguishes natural from organo-modified filler. It does not establish a complete quantitative modifier composition for this import. Table 7 does contain a producer-derived modifier drawing; that detailed structure and manufacturer composition are deliberately not imported. The modifier fraction is not established by the selected evidence.
formulation_basis.selected_groups: For each of MMT and O-MMT, Table 8 supplies one input loading of 1.0, 3.0 or 5.0 phr; the other filler column is a source dash. The six study formulations differ in filler loading or the article-stated filler composition.
formulation_basis.dash_semantics: Preserve the unused filler entry as a source dash/no listed addition; do not turn it into a measured zero-content assay.
formulation_basis.normalization_limit: Do not relabel phr as final-composite wt.% or normalize the complete recipes to 100. No final elemental formula, molecular-equivalence proof or modifier mass fraction is inferred.

sample_label_mapping.mapping_basis: Section 3.2 defines the labels by nanoclay type and loading. The 3 phr natural-MMT group is uniquely present between the 1 and 5 phr MMT groups in both selected tables. The density row is mapped to that formulation while retaining the Table 1 spelling discrepancy explicitly.
sample_label_mapping.limit: This is a transparent source-label reconciliation, not a claim that an erratum was published or that the printed source was corrected.

formulation_basis.identity_scope: Six source-qualified composite formulations are supported by the differing input recipes. Three tested specimens per group, preparation conditions, commercial input names and test conditions do not create further material identities. The unfilled NR control is not proposed as a new identity. Current-catalog novelty requires a separate check.

processing_context.reported_preparation_standard: ASTM 3182, preserving the source's preparation-standard spelling; no edition or independent compliance claim.
processing_context.matrix_mastication: Natural rubber was masticated for 5 min in a Thermo Haake Rheomix 600 internal mixer with counter-rotating rotors at 50 °C and 60 rpm.
processing_context.filler_preparation_and_mixing: Nanoclays were oven pre-dried at 60 °C for 48 h and then mixed with the rubber for 2 min. Zinc oxide, stearic acid, ZDBC and sulfur were added, followed by a further 2 min mixing/homogenization.
processing_context.vulcanization: Carver hydraulic press at 120 °C and 3 bar; no curing duration is supplied in this inspected preparation passage. The referenced prior study was not fetched to fill that gap.
processing_context.produced_sheet_dimensions: 120 × 120 × 1 mm, as reported for the produced nanocomposites. These are not asserted to be the density-test specimen dimensions.
processing_context.conditioning_limit: Filler pre-drying and vulcanization conditions are preparation context. They do not establish post-preparation conditioning, moisture content, density-test humidity or a numerical density-test temperature.
processing_context.limit: The preparation description is not a complete independently validated manufacturing specification and is not used to inflate identity counts.

property_contract.locator: PDF p.4 Table 1, density column and the six filled-NR rows
property_contract.density_basis_note: The source reports density and the Archimedes procedure, without explicitly assigning a bulk, apparent, true or crystallographic density label. Do not infer a different density-basis enum.
property_contract.central_estimator: Not specified for the selected density results. Three tested specimens do not establish that the displayed centers are arithmetic means or medians.
property_contract.plus_minus_semantics: Not specified for the selected density results. Preserve the source amplitude and unit as reported_plus_minus_unspecified; do not label it SD, SE, a confidence interval, a range or propagated measurement uncertainty.
property_contract.statistics_scope_guard: The p.19 statement that all mechanical properties are mean plus/minus standard deviation belongs to section 3.3.4 mechanical characterization. It is not extended to the density column in Table 1.

sample_count.source_statement: Three specimens were tested for each composition.
sample_count.locator: PDF p.17 section 3.3.1, density-method paragraph following Equation (1)
sample_count.limit: The later four-specimen statement belongs to the separate crosslinking-density procedure. Neither count establishes independent manufacturing batches or discloses specimen-level density measurements.

property_contract.test_method: Archimedes' principle, Mettler ME-33340 kit, with specimens weighed in air and immersed in methanol. The article gives ordinary density data reduction in Equation (1), using methanol density at the testing temperature. No density was independently recalculated in this review.
property_contract.test_standard_scope: The procedure is source-stated. No edition or independent standard-compliance verification is established.

conditioning.limit: The acetone extraction, drying and toluene exposure described later in section 3.3.1 belong to crosslinking-density determination and are not assigned to the selected density measurements.

unreported_or_unresolved: Density-specimen dimensions, conditioning duration and moisture state
Central aggregation and meaning of the density plus/minus amplitudes
Raw specimen-level measurements and independent batch variability
Explicit density-basis designation and a quantitative final-composition assay
property_contract.scope_limit: The selected values characterize the reported formulations and study context. They are not universal material constants, normalized formulation calculations, curve-digitized estimates or a new elastocaloric-performance claim. Ordinary source-side density data reduction does not become an independently recalculated property here.

required_qualifications: Preserve the Table 8 phr basis and all common formulation inputs; do not infer final wt.% or normalized composition.
Distinguish natural and organo-modified filler by the article-stated input composition, without importing Table 7 producer-derived structures or claiming independently assayed modifier chemistry.
Preserve the printed NR_3MMsT label and explain its mapping to the Table 8 NR_3MMT formulation.
Retain the exact density digits and units, undefined plus/minus semantics, three-specimen count, room-temperature qualifier and unknown conditioning.
Do not transfer mechanical mean/SD, crosslinking specimen counts or crosslinking pretreatment to these density results.
Keep source-specific attribution and distinguish transcription from catalog novelty, scientific approval, replication and legal clearance.
review_outcome.limits: No original structure asset, manufacturer diagram, source PDF/page image or raw measurement set is included. The p.21 data-availability statement says the original contributions are included in the article and further inquiries may be directed to the corresponding author; no inquiry was sent. This review does not authorize promotion of unreviewed computed examples or a change to the formal main catalog.
